items.label: Style Reigns
items.value: Discover the MAEZO Collection—a furniture line featuring streamlined designs, tapered legs, and smooth, curved transitions. Each piece adds a touch of mid-century modern flair to your home.

items.label: 2-Tier Coffee Table
items.value: Measuring 31.5"dia. x 17.7"H, this 2-tier coffee table offers ample space to keep your living room essentials organized and within reach.

items.label: Solid and Strong
items.value: Constructed from thick particleboard and MDF panels, this living room table is robust and sturdy, supporting up to 66 lb.

items.label: Hassle-Free Assembly
items.value: With labeled parts, clear instructions, and a simple structure, you can easily assemble this round coffee table in about 20 minutes.

items.value: Actual colors may vary slightly due to different lighting conditions or screen settings.
